description: This file defines classes, macros, and functions related to warning reporting control within a software project. It includes mechanisms for categorizing warnings, configuring thresholds, and managing warning events, with support for serialization, deserialization, and dynamic configuration.

classes.name: WarningReportingBoundsCategory
classes.description: Template class managing warning bounds and analysis for specific categories, including serialization, deserialization, and configuration.

classes.name: WarningReportingType
classes.description: Template class representing a warning reporting category, including analysis, serialization, and control functionalities.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy
classes.description: Singleton class acting as a proxy for warning reporting units, managing categories, events, and configuration.

classes.name: ExcludedWarnings
classes.description: Class managing lists of callsigns and modules excluded from warning reports.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Static method to configure category bounds and settings based on provided string.

methods.name: CategoryName
methods.description: Static method returning the category name.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Method to analyze a value against category bounds and determine if a warning should be reported.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes category data into a buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes category data from a buffer.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts category data to a string representation.

methods.name: IsWarning
methods.description: Checks if the current value exceeds warning bounds.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the warning event object.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Checks if the category is enabled.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Sets the enabled state of the category.

methods.name: Exclude
methods.description: Adds callsigns or modules to the exclusion list.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Releases resources and unregisters the control.
